illustration.description: Flat cartoon illustration with bold dark outlines and a subtle paper-texture finish: a smiling young boy with spiky brown hair and closed eyes, head tilted sharply to the side toward his shoulder as if stretching his neck, wearing a light sky-blue crew-neck t-shirt, skin in warm peach tones, shown from the chest up on a plain off-white background, soft even lighting, friendly sticker-like style, with two small orange zigzag crack-sound lines drawn beside the neck

graphics.description: Two small orange zigzag lightning-style crack marks flanking the 'CRACK!' sound effect near the neck
